items.definition:
a set of levels or numbers used for measuring something.
The earthquake measured 7.0 on the Richter scale.

the outside part or uppermost layer of something.
The table has a smooth surface.

an estimate of income and expenditure for a set period of time.
We need to stick to our budget.

a popular or the latest style of clothing, hair, decoration, or behavior.
She always dresses in the latest fashion.

a sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.
We need to raise funds for the new library.

all of the people born and living at about the same time.
This technology will benefit future generations.

the faculty of perceiving sounds.
Her hearing is excellent.

an outline of something, especially a person's head, seen from one side. Also, a short description of someone or something.
She updated her online profile.

a person, object, or place selected as the aim of an attack. Also, a goal or aim.
Our sales target for this month is very high.

the ability to understand something; comprehension.
We need a better understanding of the problem.

a person who acts on behalf of another
She works as a real estate agent.

the power or right to give orders
The police have the authority to stop vehicles.

a stock of a resource from which a person or place can be provided
The supply of fresh water is limited.

a particular procedure for accomplishing or approaching something
What method did you use to solve the problem?

a choice; something that is or may be chosen
We have several options for dinner tonight.

a building in which people are legally held as a punishment for a crime
He spent five years in prison for the crime.

strength
Physical strength is important for athletes.

user
The software is easy for new users.

trouble
He got into trouble for being late.

advantage
Having a car is a great advantage.

function
The main function of this button is to turn on the light.

influence
His parents had a strong influence on his career choice.

progress
We are making good progress on the project.

background
He has a strong background in computer science.

host
Our host made us feel very welcome.

journal
She writes in her journal every night.

length
What is the length of this rope?

environment, context
The story has a beautiful mountain setting.

computer programs
You need to install new software on your computer.

advertisement
I saw an interesting ad for a new car.

equilibrium, remaining amount
He lost his balance and fell.

link, relationship
There's a strong connection between diet and health.

a material made of threads; the internet
The fisherman cast his net into the sea.

a polite demand or asking
She made a request for more information.

a machine for transport
A car is a type of vehicle.

amount of space; loudness
Please turn down the volume on the TV.

help, assistance
The country sent humanitarian aid to the disaster zone.

a folder for documents; a computer document
I saved the document as a PDF file.

a type of sausage, a hot dog
He ate a frank at the baseball game.

the state or fact of having a duty to deal with something
Taking care of a pet is a big responsibility.

an idea or opinion produced by thinking
She shared her thoughts on the new project.

the quality or state of being different or diverse
The store offers a wide variety of products.

a thing designed or used for inflicting bodily harm or physical damage
The police found a weapon at the scene.

the period of being young
He spent his youth living in the countryside.

the outside limit of an object, area, or surface
Be careful not to fall off the edge of the cliff.

harm or damage
He sustained a serious injury during the game.

the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods
Freedom of religion is an important right.

the internet; a network of threads
I found the information on the web.

the assembled spectators or listeners
The audience applauded loudly after the show.

a broad inlet of the sea
We sailed into a beautiful bay.

an online journal
She writes a popular blog about travel.

a spoken or written account
Can you give me a description of the suspect?

a person who protects
The security guard stood by the door.

a town or city with a harbor
The ship arrived at the port.

an action performed or a feeling experienced in response to a situation
What was his reaction to the news?

a state of mental or emotional strain
He is under a lot of stress at work.

an act of defeating an enemy or opponent
The team celebrated their victory.

a legally recognized subject or national of a state
Every citizen has the right to vote.

a serious, unexpected, and dangerous situation
Call 911 in case of an emergency.

lack of success
His first attempt was a complete failure.

material burned to produce energy
The car needs more fuel to reach its destination.

a sufficient or more than sufficient amount
There's plenty of food for everyone.

a male royal
The prince will inherit the throne.

a period of time for an activity
The training session lasted for two hours.
